1	# Rules: Build
2	
3	- **R-7qd.** What a page lists, and what its story says, is only what the design changes compared with the app as it is now: a redesigned page the app already has shows its differences, not the whole page.
4	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/build*
5	- **R-w3n.** A story is written only when someone asks for one; a design can be built without any.
6	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/build*
7	- **R-h8x.** The agent writes one story per page, and splits it only when the parts could ship on their own, saying why.
8	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/build/stories/:group @ split-and-writing*
9	- **R-b5k.** A story says it's out of date once the design changes after it was written, and says what changed since.
10	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/build @ typical*
11	- **R-z2m.** Rewriting a story that was edited by hand asks first, because the rewrite replaces those edits.
12	- **R-u6t.** A story is kept with the design on its branch, so it's reviewed and merged with the design; a person's edits are kept the same way.
13	- **R-n4j.** A page's build session is given its stories, edits and all, and checks the build against their acceptance criteria; where a story and the design differ, the design wins.
14	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/build/stories/:group*
15	- **R-c9r.** A story never repeats what's already built: no built rules, no pages the app already has, and no rule from another page's story.
16	- **R-f6w.** Approving a screen as built in a build session saves only that screen; every other screen is still checked against the design.
17	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/sessions/:session/check/:shot*
18	  *proposed*
19	- **R-9xe.** A build session checks every screen again each time the agent's turn ends, including pages of the design it isn't building.
20	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/sessions/:session*
21	  *proposed*

text:
1	# Build - notes
2	
3	A redesign of a design's Build page (`/f/:folder/d/:design/build`): today
4	`server/views/_build.eta`, fed by `buildView()` in `server/main.js`, with
5	stories made by templates in `server/backlog.js` (`storyMarkdown`,
6	`incrementStory`, `layoutsStory`) from `increment.js`'s diff. The route
7	carries `"from": "@app/server/views/_build"`. The fake design being built
8	is "Loan offers" in borrower-portal (Offers, Compare offers, Accept an
9	offer, plus "Across the design").
10	
11	Pages: Build (`build/page`, its list `build/_pages`); a page's story
12	(`/build/stories/:group`: `build/story`, `_stories`, `_story`,
13	`_story-edit`, the `_rewrite` modal); a build session
14	(`/sessions/:session`: `build/session`, its check `_check`, one screen
15	`_shot`, `_tally`, `_open-app`; `_chat`, `_transcript`, `_entry`,
16	`_composer` are a stand-in for the design page's chat). States: typical,
17	split and writing, not approved, building, no app, all built; each has a
18	build session (typical: mid-build, one differs, two not built; building:
19	the agent working, one doesn't render, the app stopped; no app: the app
20	stopped; all built: done). Events: `story-written`, `check-done`.
21	
22	## What was wrong with it
23	
24	- The story was raw Markdown in a read-only textarea behind "Copy as story".
25	- Stories were written for the server: route patterns, `POST … updates the
26	  record at …`, file paths; each card listed routes and "the design's view".
27	- Blockers (no app, not approved, behind main, building) were stacked cards.
28	- Old layout and ds/v1.
29	- Not only what differs from the app: `increment.js` compares with the same
30	  design on main, so a redesign of an app page (`"from": "@app/…"`) in a new
31	  design was "new" and got the whole page's story; a change on top of an
32	  unbuilt main design left the unbuilt part out; whole stories listed ported
33	  routes, built rules and every design-wide rule in every story.
34	
35	## Decisions
